title: external reference schema
description: Where a result produced outside the compute stack came from. Both ends are entity references carrying their own class, so a reader resolves them without knowing which kind of entity to expect - unlike core/reference/exabyte, which names the job in the field itself and is kept as it is for jobs.

origin.description: The entity that produced the result, e.g. a measurement

subject.description: The entity the result is about, e.g. a sample

unitId.description: Id of the unit that extracted the result
